# Feature Creation Markdown

*This is where work related to the pre-processing of input data and feature generation scripts will be stored*

## Requirements & Notes

This markdown file requires data generated by ___ process.

## Set-up

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Set the markdown options for rendering this file
knitr::opts_chunk$set(include = TRUE, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE)
```

Functions used in this markdown file are stored in separate folders (named r/Q for water quantity scripts and r/TP for water quality). These libraries need to be called up along with the relevant CRAN packages.

```{r importing libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(caTools)
library(caret)
library(ncdf4)
# library(...)

i_am("PWA.Rproj") # set local project directory for here()

source(here("proj_conf.R"))
source(here(tp_r,"feature_creation.R"))
#source(...)

```

Relevant datasets can be called up all together at the start of the file. This avoids any need to search the file for paths if a path changes.

Note: we will be working with very large datasets. If these become too cumbersome for local processing, we will generate truncated or lower-resolution datasets for development purposes.

```{r importing data}

# data_obj <- read_csv(here(path_obj, "path"))
crop_data <- read.csv(here(raw_data, "crop_categories_data.csv"))
prcnt_crop <- read.csv(here(raw_data, "percent_crop_type_per_hybas_CR.csv"))

```


## Outline

- Review & format static HRU data (LULC to forcing factors transformation)
  
  - Net P fertilization (weighted max & weighted min)
  
  - Crop cover period (weighted start & weighted end)
  
  - average travel time (or HRU centroid distance from modeled / observed site)

- Review & format timeseries data

  - Runoff (PHyDAP) 
  
  - Discharge (Modeled)
  
  - Weather (temperature & solar radiation)
  
  - Water quality (observations)

- Feature generation

  - Combine static and timeseries data into sub-basins (for CR, group into 2: upper and lower)

  - Generate separate time-lag features from timeseries data (export as .csv or .Rdata files)
  
  - Join timeseries and HRU data (export as .csv or .Rdata file)
  
## Static HRU data

- Review conversion table

```{r conversion table}

# glimpse()

```

### Calculate parameters for each HRU

- Net P fertilization (weighted max & weighted min)

```{r}
max_f_wa_US <- (crop_data$max_add - crop_data$min_uptk) %>%
    weighted.mean(prcnt_crop$X7120966470)
  
min_f_wa_DS <- (crop_data$min_add - crop_data$max_uptk) %>%
  weighted.mean(prcnt_crop$X7120966730)
```

- Crop cover period (weighted start & weighted end)

```{r}
start_date_wa_US <- crop_data$start_date %>%
    weighted.mean(prcnt_crop$X7120966470) %>%
    round() %>%
    as_date(origin = "1899-12-30")
  
start_date_wa_DS <- crop_data$start_date %>%
  weighted.mean(prcnt_crop$X7120966730) %>%
  round() %>%
  as_date(origin = "1899-12-30")

end_date_wa_US <- crop_data$end_date %>%
  weighted.mean(prcnt_crop$X7120966470) %>%
  round() %>%
  as_date(origin = "1899-12-30")

end_date_wa_DS <- crop_data$end_date %>%
  weighted.mean(prcnt_crop$X7120966730) %>%
  round() %>%
  as_date(origin = "1899-12-30")
```

- average travel time (or HRU centroid distance from modeled / observed site)

### Output table with HRU parameters

```{r}
wq_crop_outputs <- data.frame(basin=c('US', 'DS'),
                              max_fert=c(max_f_wa_US,max_f_wa_DS),
                              min_fert=c(min_f_wa_US,min_f_wa_DS),
                              start_date=c(start_date_wa_US,start_date_wa_DS),
                              end_date=c(end_date_wa_US,end_date_wa_DS))
```

```{r import RDRS ncdf files}
tt_rdrs <- load_rdrs(f_path = here(raw_data,"RDRS"), var_ids = list("RDRS_v2.1_P_TT_1.5m"), dims = list("time", "lat", "lon"))

```
